<section class="r-lab" data-r-lab="07_fledging_output" aria-label="Read the fledging model and calculate expected success">
<div class="r-lab-heading"><span class="r-lab-badge">Run R</span><h3>Read the fledging model and calculate expected success</h3></div>
<p class="r-lab-note">Reads fitted coefficients and recalculates reference means. It does not refit the mixed model; fitting code is shown below.</p>
<label for="r-code-07_fledging_output">Editable R code</label>
<textarea id="r-code-07_fledging_output" class="r-lab-code" spellcheck="false" rows="11">results &lt;- readRDS(&quot;tables/within_between_20261026/aggregate_results.rds&quot;)
f &lt;- subset(results$fixed_effects, trait == &quot;fledging&quot; &amp; model == &quot;baseline&quot;)
print(f, row.names = FALSE)
b &lt;- subset(f, component == &quot;cond&quot;)
b &lt;- setNames(b$estimate, b$term)
zi &lt;- subset(f, component == &quot;zi&quot; &amp; term == &quot;(Intercept)&quot;)$estimate
# Reference: yearling, seasonal median date, centred year, random effects zero.
temperature_deviation &lt;- c(0, 1)
eta &lt;- b[&quot;(Intercept)&quot;] + b[&quot;temp_mean_c&quot;] * temperature_deviation
expected &lt;- (1 - plogis(zi)) * plogis(eta)
print(data.frame(temperature_deviation, expected), row.names = FALSE)
</textarea>
